obs_solution.efficiency_mechanism: The frame is re-derived from the live observation on every action; nothing is stored between pages, and a clause already satisfied by construction costs no action.
obs_solution.generality_mechanism: One coordinate change -- (container, identifier, path_from_id) -- serves every record-shaped page, because 'the star of that row' is not an email fact. No app is named anywhere in the module.
obs_solution.losing_routes_reason: Nearest-ancestor-holding-any-control was measured wrong (it stops at div.email-left while the star is in the sibling div.email-right); full_text identity was measured wrong (every ancestor then shows the name); class-prefix control matching was measured wrong (email-sender starts with 'email'); compiling the value once at time zero was measured wrong (the field does not exist yet).

obs_verification.synthetic_verification_necessity: None. Every observation in the fixture was captured from the real pages by this project's own chromium bridge at seed 1060, and the 130-page measurement is the real benchmark pages.

recursive_obs.real_outcome: On 130 real pages, the arm with no experience wins 66. Intersected per page with the recorded ladder: it already wins 57 of the 78 pages a search ever demonstrated (73%), so a policy adds nothing there; and it wins 9 pages no budgeted search ever demonstrated, so reading beats trying outright. The gate decide() says READ on 89 pages, on all of which the reading either wins or the miss is a page the search also could not do, and LEARN on 41, on none of which the reading won -- zero false negatives.
recursive_obs.required_capability: Deciding, from the sentence and the page alone and BEFORE acting, whether the reading already determines the action -- so that acquisition is spent only on a gap the reading named, and never on a task where it would displace the reading.

recursive_obs.self_model_claim: It can name what it can name, and it says so when it cannot. No further claim is made.
recursive_obs.stop_condition: The gate is measured on all 130 pages with zero false negatives (it never forbids learning where the reading loses), the 9 tests pass beside the 88 that came before, and the receipt claims no capability, weight, terminal or benchmark credit.
recursive_obs.why_selected_route_is_fastest_sufficient: The alternative routes were measured dead in this tree already: more demonstrations in the same state buy exactly zero bits (0/200 identified); choosing which instances to learn from tied (0.6987 vs 0.7038 for 360 extra page reads); a bigger skill library is no better than no library in-context (0.605 vs 0.602); more action primitives are refuted (0 of 37 pages proved unreachable); more search budget is near-inelastic (2.26x compute for 1 page). What remained untried was not learning harder but not learning where learning cannot help -- and that is decidable before acting.
